name: Per-serving with a promised percentage discount
why: The Empowerment Academy, 2026-07-23. Admin notes: '$3 per 9oz Kona, and waive
our destination fee as well as provide a 20% discount keep count and only
charge for the amount we actually served'. Driver: 86 yellow cups.
Billed $258.00 + tax = $283.80 with the 20% discount silently dropped. The
school was promised 20% off, so it should be 86 x $3 = $258.00 less 20% =
Cause was a contradiction between the prompt and the engine. The prompt said
applies discount.' The engine said 'extracted for audit only -- never
re-applied'. So the classifier did its job, the figure reached the ledger, and
RATE_PER_SERVING must stay 3, NOT pre-discounted to 2.40 -- the engine applies
the percentage, and doing both would discount it twice.
'waive our destination fee' is honoured by LOCATION_FEE staying 0.

cleaned.EVENT_NOTES_HTML: EVENT TYPE Invoice ATTENDEES 150-160 SERVE / KEEP COUNT 9oz yellow Kona INCLUDE  PARKING on the blacktop area PAYMENT School will be paying - send invoice after
